The search returned empty list. Maybe criteria too strict. Let's try simpler: just functional_groups_formed ['sulfonamides'] and bonds_formed ['16-7'].


<thought>The previous search returned no templates, likely because the criteria were too specific. We'll broaden the search by only requiring that the forward reaction forms a sulfonamide functional group and creates an S‑N bond (atomic numbers 16‑7). We'll omit broken functional groups.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C1=CC=C(C=C1)S(=O)(=O)N",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "bonds_formed": ["16-7"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
